subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar own a first-class, persistent external-command hook surface in shared configuration, Settings, and the CLI?
rationale: This is a new security-sensitive automation capability rather than a repair to established behavior, so technical correctness alone cannot establish product acceptance.

options.title: Accept after argv fix
options.body: Land the feature after argument boundaries round-trip exactly and the existing security contract remains covered.

options.title: Narrow to CLI and config
options.body: Support scriptable hooks without a free-form Settings editor, reducing native UI and argument-serialization surface.

options.title: Decline local execution
options.body: Keep CodexBar observability-only and leave event-driven process execution to an external consumer.

recommendation.title: Accept after argv fix
recommendation.body: Land the feature after argument boundaries round-trip exactly and the existing security contract remains covered.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the strongest available owner for deciding a new persistent command-execution and configuration boundary.
